import argparse, html, json from pathlib import Path root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] config = json.loads((root / "tools/report-target.json").read_text()) p = argparse.ArgumentParser() p.add_argument("--output") a = p.parse_args() source = (root / config["source"]).read_text() target = Path(a.output) if a.output else root / config["output"] target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) target.write_text("
" + html.escape(source) + "
\n")
